name: ctx_session
description: Cross-session memory (CCP). Actions: load (restore ~400 tok), save, status, task, finding, decision, reset, list, cleanup, snapshot, restore, resume, profile (context profiles), role (governance), budget (limits), slo (observability), diff (compare sessions), verify (output verification stats), episodes (episodic memory), procedures (procedural memory).

session_id.description: Session ID for load action (default: latest)
